breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradictory instruction in its preamble ('In this task, interpret Nx as the number of grid points including both endpoints... and set dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)'), which conflicted with the correct instruction for a periodic domain provided later in the prompt ('dx=1/Nx'). The agent correctly identified the correct instruction for the periodic domain and omitted the contradictory preamble text, aligning perfectly with the ground truth.
